# ContextInput 0.2.2 beta
This release improves language selection in conversations that contain large attachments or document previews.
- Prioritizes a confident cluster of the ten nearest text items before consulting older visible context. - Fixes Hebrew Slack conversations being diluted by older English resumes, attachments, link previews, and surrounding interface labels. - Keeps the wider 32-item context as a fallback when the nearest items are mixed. - Prevents business and messaging apps from entering the opaque-terminal fallback merely because their bundle advertises a shell-file handler. - Rejects text that only touches the focused composer's horizontal column by a few pixels, preventing adjacent Slack sidebar entries from becoming chat evidence. - Ignores Slack's paused-notifications status banner, including the fragments Electron exposes as separate accessibility text nodes. - Reduces Slack's duplicated parent message labels to the message body, removing English sender names and AM/PM metadata from Hebrew replies. - Handles both Slack's logical accessibility-string order and its visually reordered RTL presentation, including invisible bidirectional markers. - Uses a symmetric majority of distinct, strongly single-script context items to resolve sub-80-percent decisions caused by metadata-heavy accessibility labels. - Detects repeated message-body leaves inside timestamped accessibility wrappers, excluding author-name prefixes and treating the bodies as primary evidence. - Adds mirrored Hebrew and English regression coverage for the new behavior.

# ContextInput 0.2.1 beta
This is a signing and update-continuity test release. It intentionally contains no language-selection behavior changes from 0.2.0.
- Verifies an in-place Sparkle update from Build 15 to Build 16. - Retains the same bundle identifier, beta signing certificate, and update key so macOS Accessibility approval should remain enabled after relaunch.

# ContextInput 0.2.0 beta
- Adds automatic, cryptographically signed updates through Sparkle and GitHub Releases. - Adds **Check for Updates…** to the menu-bar menu and Settings. - Uses a stable beta code-signing identity so Accessibility approval can survive in-place beta updates. - Includes the previously tested ChatGPT, WhatsApp, URL-field, terminal-detection, version-display, and Command-W fixes. - Removes the unsuccessful Warp input-source workarounds. Warp remains a documented compatibility limitation.
